Generative AI Engineer — Full Stack Developer — Data Engineering & Analytics

Summary — Generative AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience building AI-powered applications, cloud-native platforms, data pipelines, analytics solutions, and enterprise SaaS products. Skilled in solution architecture, AI automation, REST APIs, CI/CD, hybrid search, vector search, observability, and data-driven systems.

Built scalable React, Next.js, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, Python, and Node.js applications supporting enterprise SaaS and e-commerce platforms.

Developed REST APIs, backend services, and third-party integrations while implementing authentication, authorization, and secure application workflows.

Designed PostgreSQL and SQL data models, optimized queries, and supported analytics, reporting, business intelligence, and data pipeline initiatives.

Built operational dashboards and reporting solutions using SQL, BigQuery, Tableau, and ThoughtSpot to support data-driven business decision-making.

Implemented AI observability, model monitoring, CI/CD automation, Docker-based deployments, and cloud-native application delivery.

Collaborated with product, business, and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions and AI automation workflows.

Participated in solution architecture, Agile ceremonies, code reviews, testing, technical documentation, troubleshooting, and production support activities.
